items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I had in the band a great personnel with Charlie Parker as one of my side men. Charlie Parker was on alto saxophone...

ctx.x: No, no. I only copied music for Fletcher Henderson for a brief time while he was in town, and the band was at the Coconut Grove. In fact I was trying -- I was hoping that I'd be able to replace him a sa pianist, because as an arranger he wasn't considered to be a very, you know, flowery pianist who was flattering the band. I think Johnny Guarneri had been in the band, who has an excellent pianist, one of my favorites today. But Fletcher was not real-ly loose enough to be a jazz piano player. And Charlie…
But unfortunately Charlie died before he got a chance to introduce me to Benny Goodman and --
